scientific_integrity: Exact analytic theorem for a continuum two-resource game; Gumbel choice probabilities and induced hard partitions distinguished; rates proved, with finite numerical corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Assumes positive C3 population density and positive C3 resource impact kernels on [0,1].
Requires an interior pure equilibrium cutoff.
Second-order cutoff coefficient can vanish for zero effective-impact-density derivative.
Does not characterize nonlinear multi-resource or discontinuous-population regimes.
Independent scientific and publication-priority audit not performed.
title: Sharp two-scale zero-noise convergence in heterogeneous two-resource congestion games
